name: Local dev servers
ownerWords: A 200 check is a good duty too. Hand the 200 checks of the wiki, the frontend app, Convex and the crawler API in the local environment to the ops chat.
goal: The wiki (localhost:5176), the search app (localhost:5174), local Convex and the local crawler-v3 API each answer 200 within 5 s, the wiki's pm2 tree stays under 4096 MB, and pm2 does not restart the wiki or search again and again. Tell the owner only when one is down, over its cap, or restarting repeatedly.

onMiss: Read the flagged items. by_design means the search app points that service away from this machine: not news. Wiki or search down: in auto-sns-agent read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs <llm-wiki|search> --lines 200 --nostream`, find the cause, and restart it with that pm2 only if it still does not answer. Convex or crawler down: run `node scripts/dev/devstack.mjs status` in auto-sns-agent and follow ops/runbooks/local-runtime.md. Over the cap or restarting repeatedly: find what holds the memory or kills the server (scripts/dev/dev-guard.mjs logs why it exits) and start one job that fixes the root and commits with scripts/repo/agent/commit.mjs. Tell the owner what broke, the numbers, and whether it answers now. Slow alone: note it under the board goal, no message. All on target: end the turn with no message.
